key.name: toggle-popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the clipboard history popup.

key.name: theme
key.description: "system" follows the GNOME light/dark style; "light" and "dark" force one.

key.name: reduce-motion
key.description: Open and close the popup without animations.

key.name: enable-images
key.description: Store copied images, such as PrtScr screenshots, in the history.

key.name: history-size
key.description: Maximum number of items kept in the history.
